overview: List of papers indexes Grew's 1938 Takao strategic report and Emmerson's 1939 report on the Gosei port's naming.

people.name: Joseph C. Grew
people.role: U.S. Ambassador to Japan; identified as the author of telegram no. 3039

people.name: John K. Emmerson
people.role: U.S. Foreign Service officer at Taihoku; identified as the author of report no. 81

subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers for File 894A.156
subfiles.about: An index records two papers concerning the strategic significance and development of harbors in Japanese-ruled Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Lists Grew's 1938 telegram on Takao's significance to Japan's Southward Advance and Emmerson's 1939 report on the Gosei port's naming.

interest: Tracks Taiwan harbor strategy and the Niitaka naming ceremony.
